          - hanlin-journal-probe
          - editor-host-tests
          - otzaria-original-editor
          - wave15-core-tests
          - wave15-component-tests
          - wave15-acceptance
      t5_component:
        description: Bounded T5 component; index-freshness also selects the fifth Apple phase
        type: choice
        options:
          - native-index
          - projection-cache
          - native-rpc
          - compatibility-pairs
          - account-pairs
          - index-freshness
        default: native-index
      ui_scope:
        description: UI27 focused diagnostic selection; no release or full matrix acceptance
        type: choice
        options:
          - FULL_SMOKE
          - STARTUP_IPAD_DIAGNOSTIC
          - NATIVE_CANCELLATION_DIAGNOSTIC
        default: FULL_SMOKE
      acceptance_lane:
        description: Existing Wave-15 lane or six isolated Release lanes after Startup is working
        type: choice
        options:
          - inspector
          - inspector-search
          - quote-drop
          - properties
          - properties-set
          - editor
          - canonical-properties
          - hanlin-native
          - hanlin-selection
          - remaining-release
        default: inspector
      acceptance_device:
        description: Disposable OS27 device family
        type: choice
        options:
          - ipad
          - iphone
        default: ipad
      acceptance_language:
        description: Actual app language; current non-editor methods require en
        type: choice
        options:
          - en
          - he
        default: en
      source_run_id:
        description: Verified Heart runtime run, or native evidence source for diagnostics
        type: string
        default: ''
      t5_r15_run_id:
        description: Original successful r15 runtime build for same-source Apple pairing
        type: string
        default: ''
      native_test_scope:
        description: Native acceptance scope (failed-ui reuses the accepted app)
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - failed-ui
          - readonly-startup
          - t5-wave1
        default: all
      require_full_acceptance:
        description: Require Full Acceptance success before IPA packaging
        type: boolean
        default: true
